interface.title: Chemiscope – interactive structure/property explorer for materials and molecules
interface.field: Computational chemistry / materials science (atomistic simulation, machine-learning descriptors)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and analysing results: looking at datasets of computed structures and properties after the calculations are done, and sharing those views
interface.what_it_is_for: Explore a dataset of atomic structures through a linked map of descriptors and properties (2D or 3D) and a 3D structure viewer, to find clusters, outliers and links between structure and properties, then save or share the view.

data.note: The app opened on the Generalized Convex Hull (ROY polymorphs) example, chosen at random. I then worked through the Arginine Dipeptide, Amorphous Silicon, Zeolites, Dielectric Response ('Molecular dipoles & polarizability') and Generalized Convex Hull examples. I also uploaded the test file showcase.json.gz, which loaded as 'Dipole and polarizability' (25 molecules). I did not open Chemical Shieldings, Qm7b or Azaphenacenes.

tree.general: Relate the structure of items in a collection to their measured or computed properties, by moving between a similarity map built from structural descriptors and a detailed view of single items, at the level of whole items (global) or of single sites inside them (local)
tree.specific: Explore a chemiscope dataset of molecules or materials: descriptor map (per-structure or per-atom) ↔ 3D structure ↔ property table

features.name: Linked scatter map and detail viewer with a selection marker
features.general: Click an item on an overview scatter plot to load it into a detail view and a property table; the selection marker stays in step whether you pick by clicking, by typing an index or with a slider
features.specific: Click a point on the descriptor map → the 3D structure loads in the viewer → the 'structure' panel shows its properties; typing an index moves the map marker. Click-picking confirmed on 2D maps only, not on a 3D map
steps: Click a point on the (2D) map
The viewer loads that structure and a red marker sits on the point
Click the 'structure' label to open the property table
Or type an index + Enter to jump there
serves_tasks: Pick an item on the map and see its structure and property values
Jump to an item by its index

features.name: Property-to-visual-channel mapping panel
features.general: Assign any numeric column to the x, y, z axes, colour and marker size of a scatter plot, each with its own scale, range, palette or transform, and a category column to the marker shape, to look for correlations
features.specific: Map settings: x/y/z axis selects with linear/log and min/max; color with palette, scale, min/max, opacity; size with transform and factor; symbol by category
steps: Open Map settings
Choose properties for x and y (and z for a 3D map)
Choose color, then palette and min/max under 'more options'
Choose size and its transform
Choose a category for the marker symbol
Reset ranges if needed
serves_tasks: Choose which quantities set the map's axes, colour, marker size and marker shape, to look for correlations
Tune the colour scale so the interesting range stands out

features.name: Range or category highlight filter
features.general: Bring forward a subset of points by a value window on any property or by a category, greying out or hiding the rest
features.specific: highlight: range (gray bg. / hide bg.) with property + min/max, or class (gray bg. / hide bg.) with a category such as type/known
steps: Pick a highlight mode (range or class; gray or hide background)
For range: pick the property and type min/max
For class: pick the category value
Read the subset that is left on the map
serves_tasks: Show only the items within a value range or in one category

features.name: Multiple linked viewers for side-by-side comparison
features.general: Open extra detail panes, each with its own colour-coded marker on the overview, so that the next pick goes to the active pane
features.specific: Duplicate viewer → a new active viewer with a distinct marker colour per viewer (the colour depends on how many viewers are open); clicking the map loads into the active viewer; × closes it
steps: Press Duplicate viewer
Click a map point (it loads into the new active viewer)
Compare the two structures
Close the extra viewer
serves_tasks: Compare two items side by side

features.name: Sequence player for items and sub-items
features.general: Play, pause or scrub through an ordered collection (and through sub-items inside each one), with the overview marker following along
features.specific: Structure and atom players: ▶/⏸, slider, frame delay and keep orientation in Visualizer settings
steps: Press ▶ on the structure (or atom) player
Watch the viewer and map marker advance
Press ⏸
Or drag the slider to a given index
Set the frame delay in Visualizer settings
serves_tasks: Step through items automatically and watch the selection move on the map
Scrub to an item with a slider

features.name: Local environment focus in a 3D structure
features.general: In a large structure, highlight the neighbourhood of the selected site within a cutoff radius, centre the camera on it, and dim or hide everything else
features.specific: Environments: center toggle, 'Highlight region' cutoff, background atoms colour (property/CPK/grey) and style (licorice/ball and stick/hide)
steps: Select an atom on the map
Turn on center
Open Environments 'more options'
Set the cutoff (e.g. 6 Å)
Set the background style to hide or licorice
serves_tasks: Isolate the neighbourhood of the selected site
Pick a single site inside a large structure and see its local neighbourhood

features.name: 3D structure rendering controls with property colouring
features.general: Change how a 3D model is drawn: representation, labels, reference axes, periodic cell and supercell, and colour by a per-site property with its own colour bar
features.specific: Visualizer settings: atoms/bonds/filling, atom labels, Axes xyz/abc, unit cell, supercell X/Y/Z, color by property, camera x/y/z/a/b/c, rotation
steps: Open Visualizer settings
Toggle representation (filling, labels)
Turn on axes and the unit cell
Choose an atom colour property
serves_tasks: Change how the 3D structure is drawn

features.name: Vector and tensor glyph overlay on a 3D structure
features.general: Draw per-item or per-site vector and tensor data on a 3D model as arrows and ellipsoids, and choose which of them to show
features.specific: Visualizer settings > Shapes multi-select (e.g. 'dipole' arrow, 'polarizability' ellipsoid) on datasets that define shapes
steps: Open a dataset that defines shapes (e.g. Dielectric Response)
Open Visualizer settings
Select which shapes to show in the Shapes list
Read the arrows or ellipsoids drawn on the structure
serves_tasks: Change how the 3D structure is drawn

features.name: Image export of the overview plot and the detail view
features.general: Save a picture of the current overview plot and of the current detail view as image files
features.specific: Map toolbar 'Download PNG' (chemiscope-map.png) and viewer PNG button (chemiscope-structure-<index>.png)
steps: Set up the map and viewer as wanted
Press 'Download PNG' in the map toolbar
Press the PNG button in the viewer
serves_tasks: Export images of the map and the structure

features.name: Session state save and dataset load
features.general: Write the current view settings (and optionally the data) to a file to share or reload later, choosing which parts to include, and bring in a data file of your own
features.specific: Load/Save modal: save settings (include map / structure settings / selected environments), save dataset (include visualization state), load dataset; 'load settings' is present but was not tested
steps: Open Load/Save
Name the file and choose what to include
Press save settings or save dataset
To bring in data, pick a file and press load dataset
(Reloading saved settings with 'load settings' was not tested)
serves_tasks: Save the current view settings so you can pick up later
Export the whole dataset together with its view
